import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_colors = {'Insomnia': '#e74c3c', 'Sleep Apnea': '#3498db', 'NaN': '#95a5a6'}
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    if pd.isna(disorder):
        mask = df['Sleep Disorder'].isna()
        label = 'No Disorder'
        color = sleep_disorder_colors['NaN']
    else:
        mask = df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder
        label = disorder
        color = sleep_disorder_colors.get(disorder, '#95a5a6')
    
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Sleep Duration'], df[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=80, label=label, color=color, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)

ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax1.legend(frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Quality by BMI Category
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_present = [cat for cat in bmi_order if cat in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='BMI Category', x='Quality of Sleep', 
            order=bmi_present, palette='Set2', ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality by BMI', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Stress Level vs Physical Activity
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', 
                     s=80, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity\n(Color: Sleep Quality)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax4.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors[:len(occupation_sleep)])
ax4.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax4.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
# Add value labels
for i, (idx, val) in enumerate(occupation_sleep.items()):
    ax4.text(val + 0.05, i, f'{val:.1f}h', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 5. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder').value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax5.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                     colors=['#95a5a6', '#e74c3c', '#3498db'])
ax5.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 6. Heart Rate vs Age colored by Gender
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    mask = df['Gender'] == gender
    ax6.scatter(df[mask]['Age'], df[mask]['Heart Rate'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=60, label=gender, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax6.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate vs Age by Gender', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax6.legend(frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 7. Daily Steps distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax7.hist(df['Daily Steps'], bins=25, color='#2ecc71', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax7.axvline(df['Daily Steps'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {df["Daily Steps"].mean():.0f}')
ax7.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Distribution of Daily Steps', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax7.legend(frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
